svg.title: DIA-004C · The heavier ball keeps going
svg.desc: An engraved plate of two wrecking balls hung from one girder and swinging toward each other. The left ball is enormous and stands for OpenAI's projected compute spending through 2030, 856 billion dollars. The right ball is the size of a marble and stands for one year of the UK AI Security Institute's budget, 84 million dollars. Their weights are drawn in the true ratio of 10,190 to 1.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 4 · WHO WAS SUPPOSED TO SLOW IT
US CAISI's ball, at $10 million a year,
If they meet at equal speed, the large
ball keeps all but a five-thousandth
Drawn to weight, as two balls of the same iron: 10,190 parts to 1, which makes the small ball a twenty-second as wide.
DIA-004C · Projected spending against one year of the largest oversight budget, as two wrecking balls drawn to weight.
